name: future-electronics
description: MCP server for the Future Electronics Product Information API: part, stock, lead time, and price-break lookup by manufacturer part number

future_api_key.title: Future Electronics API key
future_api_key.description: Your Future Electronics license key (request one at https://www.futureelectronics.com/api-solutions). Claude Code stores it in secure storage, never in a settings file.

workspace_dir.title: Workspace folder
workspace_dir.description: Optional. The one folder where the server reads BOM files and writes exports; it never touches files outside it. Leave blank to use Documents/Future Electronics MCP in your home folder (or Future Electronics MCP in your home folder if there is no Documents folder).
